name: Bad Leadership
overview: Scripture reveals that bad leadership is fundamentally opposed to God's design, as wickedness in rulers is detestable and undermines the righteousness upon which authority is established. Pride and a haughty spirit lead to downfall, and when rulers embrace lies, corruption spreads among their followers. The consequences of ungodly leadership are severe, causing sorrow among the people and destruction of God's flock, as the Lord warns against pastors who scatter His sheep.
